ex.s: Not long ago, my fifth-grade son Kevin asked me about the meaning of a word in a novel.

ex.s: While going through the pages, he kept saying, wide-eyed: “How can there be this many words?” After a while, he looked at me and asked, “Do you know all these words, Mom?” I smiled, “I definitely do not know all these words,” I said.

ex.t: 重要的不是单词本身，也不是我们如何学习它们，而是那份想了解它们的渴望、好奇心和求知欲。
